tour.name: Product Demo
tour.description: A six-stop tour of the Northwind demo, spanning the dashboard, projects and settings.

steps.label: Key metrics
steps.description: The health of the workspace at a glance. The row is named with aria-label, so this step keeps pointing at it no matter how the numbers inside change.

steps.label: Create a project
steps.description: The primary action on the dashboard. Its accessible name is the button's own text, which is exactly what the locator matches on.

steps.label: Filter projects
steps.description: Type here to narrow the table by project name or owner. The input is found by its <label for> text, not by its position in the toolbar.

steps.label: The projects table
steps.description: Every project in the workspace. The table carries aria-label="Projects", which is what makes a step on a data-driven element durable — no row text, no index.

steps.label: Workspace name
steps.description: Rename the workspace. A real <label for> gives the field an accessible name, so this step survives a redesign of the form around it.

steps.label: Save changes
steps.description: Nothing is persisted until you save. That is the end of the tour — press Esc or the mode switch to leave.
